title: Replace the tautological "reason never changes what is confirmed" guard with an independent oracle
outcome: The unconfirmed-root reason test compares the confirmed/unconfirmed judgment against an independent copy of the previous boolean logic, so a refactor that changes which roots are confirmed fails it.
acceptance: the guard in src/tests/engram_unconfirmed_root_reasons.rs compares against an oracle that does not call engram_turn_root_capture_locked's own projection
the test fails when a reason projection is changed to alter a confirmation decision
